name: butter_analog
comment: Sig: butter through the shared analog/digital pipeline (cheby-style). Covered: analog lowpass Wn=100 rad/s (s-domain Butterworth polynomial, exact to 15 digits), analog bandpass [40 150] (BW^2=12100 numerator gain), analog highpass 'high'+'s' composed flags, and the DIGITAL path butter(4,0.5) which must stay bit-identical after the re-routing (MATLAB b(5)=0.09398085143379442). The 's' flag keeps Wn in rad/s (any positive value) — the old Wn-in-(0,1) rejection is the fixed bug.
